title: DNS between a VPC and a data center
claim: Inbound endpoints bring data center queries to VPC Resolver; outbound endpoints carry VPC queries to the data center when a forwarding rule matches.
alt: An architecture with a data center on the left and a VPC on the right, joined by Direct Connect or a VPN. Data center DNS servers forward queries to an inbound endpoint, which reaches VPC Resolver and a private hosted zone. An instance's query goes through VPC Resolver, a forwarding rule and an outbound endpoint back to the data center DNS servers.

edges.say: The data center DNS servers forward queries for the private zone's domain to the inbound endpoint.
VPC Resolver answers them from the private hosted zone.
An instance asks VPC Resolver for a name that the data center hosts.
A forwarding rule matches the name, and the outbound endpoint sends the query to the data center DNS servers.
